newsitem.title: USA: CBOT July soybeans fall sharply, funds, spreads.
newsitem.headline: CBOT July soybeans fall sharply, funds, spreads.

text.p: CBOT July soybeans fell sharply in late trade Monday on commodity fund selling and profit taking on the July/November spread, floor traders said.
"It's all about the spreaders right now," said one floor trader.
Commodity funds were also sellers in July and pushed the market into sell-stop orders. Merrill Lynch sold one million bushels of July, floor sources said.
At 1231 CDT, July soybeans were down 12 cents per bushel at $8.68-1/2, with other months up seven to down 5-3/4.
